# Gobiya: Strategic Organic Traffic Recovery & B2B Revenue Domination
> High-performance search and pipeline engineering agency specialized in reversing Google core update penalties, restoring organic search traffic, and constructing high-yielding B2B lead generation assets that scale revenue.

## Core Outcomes & Objectives
- **Organic Traffic Recovery**: Reversing manual actions and HCU/Core Update drops to restore search visibility, recover lost traffic, and safeguard organic traffic revenue.
- **B2B Revenue Generation**: Engineering automated sales pipeline systems and B2B lead generation engines that deliver predictable customer acquisition and contract volume.
- **Search & AI Dominance**: Securing high-value search real estate via semantic entity audits, technical schema building, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to dominate modern AI-search models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity).

## Executive Philosophy
Gobiya shifts SEO from a cost-center to a revenue-driver. We bypass vanity metrics to focus strictly on commercial outcomes: restored organic traffic streams, secure search dominance, and predictable business-to-business pipeline growth.

## Strategic Direction
Led by a veteran principal strategist with 25+ years of forensic search analysis and B2B pipeline engineering experience.
